atq.text: Tocasia, the archaeologist who runs the school at Argive, takes the orphaned brothers Urza and Mishra to the sacred cave of Koilos, where Urza finds the Mightstone and Mishra discovers the weakstone.
Each brother craves both stones and they begin to mistrust each other, and their rivalry ends in an explosion that kills Tocasia and many others, after which the brothers split ways.
Mishra later builds his stronghold on the foundation of the School of Tocasia in the Kher Ridges.

h1r.text: Tocasia records in her journal that a strange device became indistinguishable from another on her workbench within minutes.
